title: Every light on
camera: Wide. Slow drift right with slight handheld float.
action: Moon, drifting clouds, fog. Every window lit, porch lights on. Nobody.
sound: Low wind, distant drone, faint electrical hum of a whole town.

title: The first flicker
camera: Drift settles, eases toward the house with the attic window.
action: Attic window stutters twice. Everything else stays perfectly steady.
sound: Tiny filament buzz + tick, synced to each flicker.

title: The push begins
camera: Slow creeping dolly-in. Fence + trees fly past in parallax.
action: Flickers grow longer. Weathervane creaks. Fog thins.
sound: Drone rises in pitch, heartbeat-like sub pulse fades in.

title: Stutter
camera: Close — window fills the middle third.
action: Rapid triple flicker. The room behind the curtains looks empty.
sound: Buzz crackles harder; wind drops out.

title: Blackout
action: Window goes dark. One half-second flash: still empty.
sound: Near silence. Just the hum… and a single floorboard creak.

title: Someone is there
camera: Light snaps back; push slows to a crawl.
action: A tall, narrow silhouette, too close to the glass. Breathing. Still.
sound: Low string-like swell (synth), sub drop on the reveal.

title: It tilts its head
action: Head slowly tilts — too far. Light dips once.
sound: Swell holds; high dissonant tone creeps in.

title: Every light off
action: Every window in town cuts at once. The figure lingers in the dark glass.
sound: Hard ‘thunk’ of power cutting, swell stops dead. Silence.
